scope: 1 newly recognized component, 1 fully supported card. Prior supported programs and metadata unchanged.
source: Rainier English card text included verbatim per component; conversion input matched by stable card ID.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Eevee Fetch and Hide: view opponent hand, choose one Item, put it on bottom of that opponent deck. Rainier English says opponent reveals the hand.
Resolve text in order and move only a card from the specified shown hand, preserving ownership; bottom placement does not shuffle. Existing current-ruleset Item classification keeps Tools separate.

evidence.name: Fetch and Hide
evidence.textEn: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put an Item card you find there on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
evidence.textZh: 查看对手的手牌，选择其中1张物品放回对手的牌库下方。
